mapper.select: SELECT RA.ROLE_ASSIGN_ID, RA.ROLE_ID, RA.EMP_ID, RA.SCOPE_TYPE_CD, RA.SCOPE_ID, RA.ENABLED AS ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_ENABLED, R.ROLE_ID AS ROLE_ROLE_ID, R.ROLE_CD AS ROLE_ROLE_CD, R.ROLE_NM AS ROLE_ROLE_NM, R.ROLE_EXPLN AS ROLE_ROLE_EXPLN, R.FRST_RGTR_ID AS ROLE_FRST_RGTR_ID, R.FRST_REG_DT AS ROLE_FRST_REG_DT, R.LAST_MDFR_ID AS ROLE_LAST_MDFR_ID, R.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS ROLE_LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT RA JOIN TB_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = RA.ROLE_ID WHERE RA.EMP_ID = #{empId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT ( ROLE_ASSIGN_ID, ROLE_ID, EMP_ID, SCOPE_TYPE_CD, SCOPE_ID, ENABLED ) SELECT (SELECT NVL(MAX(ROLE_ASSIGN_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT), #{roleId}, #{empId}, #{scopeTypeCd}, #{scopeId}, #{enabled} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT RA WHERE RA.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND RA.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND RA.SCOPE_TYPE_CD = #{scopeTypeCd} AND RA.SCOPE_ID = #{scopeId} )
